description: This file appears to be a header file declaring functions related to parameter registration for quantized operations in PyTorch's ATen library. It includes function prototypes for registering linear, embedding, and convolution parameters, with template support for different spatial dimensions.

methods.name: register_linear_params
methods.description: Registers parameters for linear operations in quantized models.
